system.description: You name the charge aloud and answer it with silver. Make an attack with your rapier or a loaded pistol. On a hit, it deals normal damage and the foe is Stupefied until the end of its next turn: it has no reaction, and creatures defend against its gloom abilities with Boon.

outcomes.ruin: Your voice cracks on the charge: no effect, and this power cannot Stupefy that foe again this encounter.
